description: Teacher region classes mapped onto Capy line roles for the native role experiment (bench/parsers/scripts/native_roles). A line takes the class of the smallest region holding >= 50% of its area; 'figure' regions give 'figure_label' lines and 'table' regions 'table_cell' lines. null = no opinion (the line is unlabelled by that teacher).

agreement.rule: Both teachers must give the same role. Exceptions, for classes V3 lacks or under-uses: V3 body + Egret list -> list; V3 body/heading + Egret code -> code; V3 body/heading + Egret furniture -> furniture.
